greeting.findingRhythm: You're finding your rhythm — one gentle day at a time.

firstCheckin.title:
Your first check-in
starts your baseline.
firstCheckin.body: Just 30 seconds — mood, sleep, and how you feel today. That's all we need.

normalCheckin.noCheckinBody: A quick mood check-in keeps support gentle, early, and easier to understand.
normalCheckin.checkinDoneBody: Thank you for being honest with yourself. You can update it anytime if something shifts.
normalCheckin.nudge: We'll gently check in with you {{time}}.

cards.moodTrendEmpty: Your trend will appear here once you check in a few times.
cards.emotionalCheckDueBody: Takes about 2 minutes, just for you.

questions.title: How are you feeling today?
questions.subtitle: Choose the one that fits today best.
questions.help: There's no wrong answer — just how today feels.

questions.title: How did you sleep last night?
questions.subtitle: Even if you woke up often — answer for how it really felt.
questions.help: Broken sleep is normal right now. No need for perfect sleep.

questions.title: How much energy do you have today?
questions.subtitle: At your own pace, not anyone else's.

questions.title: How much is on your mind today?
questions.subtitle: Whatever is there is okay to name.

problemTags.title: What feels hardest today?
problemTags.subtitle: Pick up to 2. This only appears when your answers suggest extra care would help.
problemTags.otherPlaceholder: Tell us what feels hardest today.

journal.title: Would you like to write a little more about today?
journal.subtitle: This is optional. You can leave it blank.
journal.placeholder: Write anything you want to remember, release, or explain about today.

babyConnection.title: How did moments with your baby feel today?
babyConnection.subtitle: However it felt is okay. There's no right answer here.

supportNeed.title: Do you need our care team to reach out to you today?
supportNeed.subtitle: Your recent check-ins suggest you should not have to carry this alone. It's completely your choice.

tinyGoal.promptBody: Pick one small thing for today — or skip, no pressure.
tinyGoal.noPressure: No pressure — it'll be waiting on your home screen.
tinyGoal.skipMsg: That's okay — rest is a goal too. We'll suggest another tomorrow. 💛

result.numbersNote: Numbers are tucked away. Start with what support fits next.
result.supportRequestBody: Your pattern suggests you should not carry this alone. Open help if you want a guided next step.

epds.title: Emotional Check
epds.sensitiveNote: If this feels urgent, use I Need Help right away. Answer honestly and keep going at your pace.
epds.scoreExplain: This is your Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS) score. It's a screening tool, not a diagnosis — your care team can help you make sense of it.

crisisCards.recommendSupportBody: Please open help right now and reach out to a doctor, midwife, or crisis line.
crisisCards.noticedLastAnswerBody: If those thoughts ever feel urgent, open help immediately. You matter deeply and support is available now.

steady.body: Your answers suggest you are steady right now. Keep the daily rhythm going so changes stay easier to spot.
steady.quote: Small, steady steps can carry a lot of weight.

gentle.body: Your answers point to early strain. Gentle support and simple next steps can help keep this from building.
gentle.quote: Noticing the pattern early is a strength.

extra.body: Your answers suggest you may benefit from extra support right now. Reaching out soon would be a good next step.
extra.quote: You do not have to carry this stretch alone.

immediate.body: Your answers point to a high-need moment. Please open help right now and contact support immediately.

safety.title: How can we help right now?
safety.subtitle: Choose what feels right — you can change your mind anytime.

trusted.title: Reach someone I trust
trusted.desc: A partner, family member, or friend

safe.title: I'm with someone safe
safe.desc: I just need to steady myself

urgent.title: I don't feel safe right now

trusted.title: Reach out to someone you trust
trusted.body: You do not have to explain everything. Even "I'm having a hard day and need someone nearby" is enough.

hospital.title: Ask your maternity care team
hospital.body: Use this for questions about recovery, feeding, sleep, or how you have been feeling. If you do not feel safe right now, use the urgent option below instead.
hospital.note: Best for non-emergency recovery, feeding, sleep, or medication questions.
hospital.callNote: Call using the number on your hospital discharge papers

safe.title: Let's steady this moment together
safe.body: You're safe right now. A short breathing or grounding exercise can help.

urgent.title: You should not be alone with this
urgent.body: If you feel you might hurt yourself or the baby, reach a person now. Use a local emergency number if these lines are not right for where you are.
urgent.cta: Stay with me while I call

mentalHealth.name: Mental health hotline
mentalHealth.desc: Thailand Department of Mental Health support line.

emergency.name: Medical emergency
emergency.desc: Thailand emergency medical service. Outside Thailand, call your local emergency number.

breathing.title: 4-7-8 Breathing
breathing.desc: A calming breath technique that activates your nervous system's rest response

grounding.desc: This 5-4-3-2-1 technique anchors you to the present moment
